task.title: Fix: The documented farewell behavior is broken: ruby test/farewell_test.rb fails because Farewell.for("Ada") returns "Goodby
task.description_markdown:
# Problem

The documented farewell behavior is broken: ruby test/farewell_test.rb fails because Farewell.for("Ada") returns "Goodbye, Ada" instead of "Goodbye, Ada!". Diagnose the root cause, add or preserve regression coverage, apply the smallest fix, run both documented test commands, and publish the verified result.

step.name: Verify
step.instruction: Independently verify the published fix and remote commit against the problem and accepted artifacts.
